then.text: Mind the bread doesn't get dropped in the moat.

else.text: Brown bread for the Butler? It's just out of the bastable. That's a pot oven, on the turf fire, with coals heaped on the lid.
Buttermilk, wholemeal, soda, salt. No yeast. And a cross cut on top to let the fairies out.
You've got a warm loaf of brown bread for the banquet.

bean_an_ti.text: Bean an tí, that's 'woman of the house'. Sit in by the fire. The kettle's always on the crane.
In the old days the fire never went out. It was raked over with ashes at night and blown back to life in the morning. Two hundred years, some hearths.

cottage_settle.text: That's a settle bed. A bench by day, a bed by night, for whichever child lost the argument.
The half-door? Top open for light and chat, bottom shut for the hens and the pig. Very civilised.
